properties.description: Mapping Data Flow for MCF Cuentas multi-entity transformation. Maps DataStage J139_Transbk_Mcf_Cuentas: Seq_MCF_C input (CSeqFileStage) -> multiple CTransformerStage and CSeqFileStage outputs for 22 LDM entities. Pivot stages: Pivote_ACI (Account_Card_Income), Pivote_AAH (Account_Abuse_History), Pivote_CF (Card_Feature). These are CCustomStage.CC_GUI pivot operations transposing rows to columns.

typeProperties.script:
// MANUAL ACTION REQUIRED: Implement full routing and derivation logic
// See DataStage job J139_Transbk_Mcf_Cuentas CTransformerStage definitions in DSX
scriptLines: // Auto-generated skeleton. Implement Filter_* and DerivedColumn_* transforms.
// Each sink receives a filtered/projected subset of the source rows.
// Reference DataStage derivation expressions in DSX CTransformerStage stages.

annotations: datastage_source_stage: Seq_MCF_C (CSeqFileStage, pipe-delimited, from Extraccion output)
CRITICAL_manual_action_1: Implement full derivation expressions for each LDM entity from DSX CTransformerStage

CRITICAL_manual_action_2: Pivote_ACI (Account_Card_Income) and Pivote_AAH (Account_Abuse_History) are CCustomStage.CC_GUI pivot operations - implement as ADF Pivot transformation or Databricks notebook
CRITICAL_manual_action_3: Pivote_CF (Card_Feature) is also a pivot stage - same as above
CRITICAL_manual_action_4: Coll_ACL (Account_Credit_Limit) is a collector pattern - implement as ADF aggregate or Databricks
CRITICAL_manual_action_5: EIH_Retro (External_Identification_Hist) has retroactive lookup logic - verify derivations
CRITICAL_manual_action_6: System_Of_Record_Dt = FechaProceso parameter conversion to Teradata DATE format
CRITICAL_manual_action_7: File_Source_Cd = 'MCF' (constant string) for all entities
adf_pattern: multi-output fan-out using conditional split (ConditionalSplit transformation) per entity
